# tcpshield_country_firewall_rules (Data Source)

Lists the entries of a network's country firewall.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "tcpshield_country_firewall_rules" "all" {
  network_id = data.tcpshield_network.main.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `network_id` (Number) Network to list.

### Read-Only

- `rules` (Attributes List) The entries. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Read-Only:

- `country_code` (String) ISO country code.
- `country_id` (Number) TCPShield's numeric country id (see `country_code` / `country_name` on an existing entry).
- `country_name` (String) Country name.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (Number) Numeric entry id.
- `whitelist` (Boolean) `true` allows the source, `false` blocks it.
